children.name: Leptomeria acida R.Br.
children.description: Leptomeria acida, known as acid drops or sour currant-bush, is an apparently leafless parasitic shrub, found on the coast and ranges in eastern Australia.

children.name: Leptomeria aphylla R.Br.
children.description: Leptomeria aphylla, commonly known as leafless currant-bush is a shrub that is native to south-eastern Australia.
